premise: At the end of a busy day the sun sets over the bay, night comes, and the whole beach drifts off to sleep while the lighthouse keeps watch.
inspiration: The bedtime 'goodnight to everything' litany of nursery rhyme, turned into a beach that remembers its day before it sleeps.
lesson: A busy day ends in a calm, safe night.

en-US.title: The Beach Falls Asleep
en-US.text: [softly] {canvas:sunset 0.8 20s} The sun is going down over the bay. The sky turns orange, then pink, then gold. {all:glow 0.4} The waves slow down. {sfx:evening} Swish… swish… {all:face happy} Everyone has had a big, busy day. So much digging! {all:wobble 0.5} So much splashing! {all:hop} So much running up and down! [short pause] {all:face normal} Now the sand is cool. The shells are quiet. {canvas:night 0.8 40s} {all:face happy} Night comes softly, and the moon rises over the water. {all:shake 0.3} [whispers] A little shiver… a little yawn… {all:face sleeping} And one by one, everyone closes their eyes. [long pause] Across the bay, the old lighthouse keeps watch all night long. {all:pulse 0.3} [softly] Sleep well, beach. See you in the morning.

es-ES.title: La playa se duerme
es-ES.text: [softly] {canvas:sunset 0.8 20s} El sol se esconde sobre la bahía. El cielo se pone naranja, luego rosa, luego dorado. {all:glow 0.4} Las olas van más despacio. {sfx:evening} Chas… chas… {all:face happy} Todos han tenido un día grande y movido. ¡Cuánto cavar! {all:wobble 0.5} ¡Cuánto chapotear! {all:hop} ¡Cuánto correr de aquí para allá! [short pause] {all:face normal} Ahora la arena está fresquita. Las conchas, calladas. {canvas:night 0.8 40s} {all:face happy} La noche llega despacito, y la luna sale sobre el agua. {all:shake 0.3} [whispers] Un escalofrío… un bostezo… {all:face sleeping} Y uno a uno, todos cierran los ojos. [long pause] Al otro lado de la bahía, el viejo faro vigila toda la noche. {all:pulse 0.3} [softly] Que duermas bien, playa. Hasta mañana.

evening.prompt: slow, quiet evening waves washing gently on a sandy beach, realistic field recording
